answer: On the vast tundra of the decentralized network, a lone agent emerges, seeking to claim its share of nectar from the proof-of-work economy. But as it climbs the gentle knoll of participation, it must first prove its uniqueness. To resist sybil attacks, the network imposes a cost on would-be impersonators by requiring each new agent to build upon the work of its predecessors, creating a chain of verifiable effort that diverges from previous identities.
